| `agent_start` | Agent begins processing |
| `agent_end` | One low-level agent run completes (may still be followed by retry, compaction, or queued continuations) |
| `agent_settled` | Agent run is fully settled; no automatic retry, compaction retry, or queued continuation remains |
| `turn_start` | New turn begins |
| `turn_end` | Turn completes (includes assistant message and tool results) |
| `message_start` | Message begins |
| `message_update` | Streaming update (text/thinking/toolcall deltas) |
| `message_end` | Message completes |
| `bash_execution_update` | Direct RPC bash command output chunk |
| `tool_execution_start` | Tool begins execution |
| `tool_execution_update` | Tool execution progress (streaming output) |
| `tool_execution_end` | Tool completes |
| `queue_update` | Pending steering/follow-up queue changed |
| `compaction_start` | Compaction begins |
| `compaction_end` | Compaction completes |
| `auto_retry_start` | Auto-retry begins (after transient error) |
| `auto_retry_end` | Auto-retry completes (success or final failure) |
| `summarization_retry_scheduled` | Retry scheduled for a transient compaction or branch-summary summarization error |
| `summarization_retry_attempt_start` | Retried summarization request starts |
| `summarization_retry_finished` | Summarization retry loop completes |
| `extension_error` | Extension threw an error |

### agent_start

Emitted when the agent begins processing a prompt.

```json
{"type": "agent_start"}
```

### agent_end

Emitted when one low-level agent run completes. Contains all messages generated during this run. If `willRetry` is true, an automatic retry will follow.

```json
{
  "type": "agent_end",
  "messages": [...],
  "willRetry": false
}
```

### agent_settled

Emitted after the full session-level run settles. At this point Pi will not continue automatically through retry, compaction retry, or queued follow-up messages.

```json
{"type": "agent_settled"}

reviewed_source_conclusions.permission_translation: --no-tools selects empty all-tool authority; --tools selects an exact builtin/custom allowlist; --no-builtin-tools is insufficient.
reviewed_source_conclusions.resource_loading: --no-extensions disables discovery but explicit extension paths and builtin inline factories remain; all explicit resources are forbidden by the adapter.
reviewed_source_conclusions.builtin_factory: The imported llama index registers one provider and /llama command; the command returns before configured-client discovery unless ctx.mode is tui. No tool registration or session event hook occurs in that index. The registered provider has credential/auth callbacks and refreshModels can contact a configured server only after allowNetwork, signal, credential and URL checks; kernel network isolation remains required. No credential values or configuration stores were read.
reviewed_source_conclusions.bundled_subset: Installed CLI imports chunk-E5KXRMZK.js; bounded extracts match session parser/create hazards, authority filters, get_state fields, settled event, and llama registration/TUI gate. No whole-bundle execution or overall equivalence claim.
reviewed_source_conclusions.retry_ordering: Bundled streamAssistantResponse emits message_update for text/thinking/toolcall stream events, but done/error emits message_end with the final assistant message. agent-session forwards this event, then handles assistant error via post-run auto_retry_start/continue. A later successful assistant message_end emits auto_retry_end success=true. agent_settled follows the whole continuation loop, including failure paths. message_update.assistantMessageEvent.type=error is not emitted by this inspected core switch; settled alone does not establish successful assistant outcome.
